title: Catch up to 2026 RustCrypto + wolfSSL 5.9.4, publish to crates.io
description: November 2026 catch-up: every crate moved to the 2026 stable RustCrypto releases (digest 0.11, cipher 0.5, aead 0.6, signature 3.0, crypto-common 0.2, hybrid-array) and to wolfSSL 5.9.4. Along the way, crates that had been broken since the edition-2024 move were fixed, the vendored build gained the TLS layer, the wolftpm family was renamed to wolftpm2 (the crates.io name belongs to wolfSSL), and 16 crates were published. main: 2dcf91a..1078e71.
